description: Read-only, offline tool that scans the vault library (Recipes, Shaders, Presets, Components, Setlists), extracts lineage frontmatter (parent_recipe, source_assets, remix_of, forked_from), and emits a lineage graph. Output as JSON (machine-consumable), Mermaid (paste into docs), or Graphviz DOT. No TouchDesigner connection required.

cluster_by.description: Grouping for Mermaid subgraph / DOT cluster.

include_orphans.description: When false, exclude nodes with no lineage edges.

kinds.description: Categories to scan. 'all' includes every category.

vault_path.description: Absolute path override; falls back to TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

name: library_lineage_graph
title: Library lineage graph
